description: Use this when someone asks how busy their gym is or how many appointments or sessions are booked each day, past or upcoming. Returns booking counts per UTC day for one gym, whatever their status, for any window of at most 31 days (the next 7 by default); counting stops at 100. Not for counting cancellations or seeing which members are booked.

endTime.description: End of the range as an ISO 8601 date-time, after startTime and at most 31 days later; defaults to 7 days after the start

gymId.description: Id of one of the user's gyms, as the gym list returns it (24 lowercase hex characters)

startTime.description: Start of the range as an ISO 8601 date-time; defaults to now

name: get_gym_schedule_summary

days.description: One row per UTC day that has bookings, canceled ones included. Aggregate counts only: appointment ids and times, member information, services, notes, trainer data and attendance history are never returned.

recordCountIsLowerBound.description: True when more than 100 bookings fall in the range

title: Count bookings per day
